notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Jadzi by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood token.
When the Blood enters the battlefield, Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning Ovalchase Daredevil from your graveyard to your hand.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a 2/2 Skeleton Pirate creature token.
Repeat.
Resolve all Jadzi abilities, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.

uses.name: Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios // Journey to the Oracle
